subject: science
question:
Question refers to the following information.
People with cystic fibrosis have thickened mucus and fluid buildup in their lungs. Cystic fibrosis is a recessive disorder caused by a mutation in a single gene. Individuals can be tested to determine if they are symptomless carriers of this disorder.
A scientist tested 100 children whose parents were all symptomless carriers of the disorder to learn about the children’s genetic makeup. The table shows the scientist’s findings.
Genetic Makeup of Children Tested
Column 1: Group; Column 2: Genetic makeup of children whose mothers and fathers were carriers
Group 1: 24 children who have the disorder
Group 2: 51 children who are carriers
Group 3: 25 children who do not have any alleles for the disorder and are not carriers
The scientist used F(uppercase F) to represent the dominant allele for the disorder and f (lowercase f) to represent the recessive allele.
A single gene mutation causes cystic fibrosis.
Which statement best describes how the gene mutation affects an individual with the disorder?
choices: A defective protein is produced.
Cells lining the airway cannot divide.
RNA transcription fails in cells.
Chromosomes fail to separate during meiosis.
answer: A. A defective protein is produced.

question:
Question refers to the growth of bacteria.
A scientist studied the growth rate of a species of bacterium. The scientist introduced some of the bacteria into a flask of nutrient-rich solution and monitored the growth of the bacterial population by measuring the number of living cells in the solution.
The graph below shows the growth of the bacterial population over time in hours (h).
[Figure: Graph showing the population growth curve of bacteria. The X axis is labeled Time (hours) and ranges from 0 to 27 in 3 hour increments. The Y axis is labeled number of living cells and ranges from 10 to the sixth power to 10 to the tenth power in increments of 1 power. Points are plotted on the graph to indicate the bacterial growth; the points are connected by a line. Between 0 to 3 hours, there are 7 points plotted in the region of 10 to the seventh power to 10 to the 8.2 power. Between 3 and 6 hours, there are 6 points plotted from 10 to the 8.5 power to 10 to the 9.3 power. Between 6 and 9 hours, there are 4 points plotted between 10 to the 9.3 power to 10 to the 9.5 power. There are points plotted at (12, 10 to the .95 power), (16, 10 to the .95 power), (20, 10 to the .89 power), and (25, 10 to the .81 power).]
The scientist wanted to determine the effect of an antibiotic on the growth of the bacterium. To a second flask of nutrient-rich solution with the bacterial cells, he added the antibiotic, and monitored the growth of the bacterial population.
The data showed that most of the bacteria in the solution died, but some survived. The scientist concluded that some of the bacteria were resistant to the antibiotic.
Explain why some of the bacteria were resistant to the antibiotic, based on the theory of evolution.
answer: Scoring guide — Complete: Student response correctly explains that some of the bacteria resistant to the antibiotic had a genetic mutation. The resistant bacteria divided passing the genetic mutation to the next generation.

question:
The overuse of antibiotics has led to an increase in the prevalence of antibiotic-resistant strains of bacteria. Explain how this occurred.
Answer box.
answer: Scoring guide — Complete: Student response explains that a mutation occurred in the DNA of some bacteria, so they were resistant to the antibiotic. The antibiotic-resistant bacteria then passed the resistance on (DNA mutation) when they reproduced. Note: Acceptable synonyms for mutates: changes DNA, modifies genes, transforms genetic material. (Requires a reference to DNA, genes, genome, genetics, genotype, chromosomes, or hereditary material). Unacceptable synonyms for mutates: evolve or adapt to become more resistant, changes, develops. Acceptable synonyms for reproduce: multiply, spread Unacceptable synonyms for reproduce: thrive, overtime, regenerate

question:
Question refers to the growth of bacteria.
A scientist studied the growth rate of a species of bacterium. The scientist introduced some of the bacteria into a flask of nutrient-rich solution and monitored the growth of the bacterial population by measuring the number of living cells in the solution.
The graph below shows the growth of the bacterial population over time in hours (h).
[Figure: Graph showing the population growth curve of bacteria. The X axis is labeled Time (hours) and ranges from 0 to 27 in 3 hour increments. The Y axis is labeled number of living cells and ranges from 10 to the sixth power to 10 to the tenth power in increments of 1 power. Points are plotted on the graph to indicate the bacterial growth; the points are connected by a line. Between 0 to 3 hours, there are 7 points plotted in the region of 10 to the seventh power to 10 to the 8.2 power. Between 3 and 6 hours, there are 6 points plotted from 10 to the 8.5 power to 10 to the 9.3 power. Between 6 and 9 hours, there are 4 points plotted between 10 to the 9.3 power to 10 to the 9.5 power. There are points plotted at (12, 10 to the .95 power), (16, 10 to the .95 power), (20, 10 to the .89 power), and (25, 10 to the .81 power).]
Over which time period did the number of living bacteria increase at the greatest rate?
choices: Between hours 0 and 1
Between hours 1 and 8
Between hours 8 and 16
Between hours 16 and 24
answer: B. Between hours 1 and 8

subject: science
question:
Heavy rain on a hillside has a caused a rockslide. All vegetation has disappeared. Gradually, plant life moves back into the area and species are replaced by other species.
In which order are the plants most likely to appear, from earliest to latest?
choices: Mosses and lichens, grasses, shrubs, pines, oaks
Grasses, shrubs, pines, mosses and lichens, oaks
Shrubs, grasses, mosses and lichens, oaks, pines
Pines, mosses and lichens, shrubs, oaks, grasses
answer: A. Mosses and lichens, grasses, shrubs, pines, oaks

subject: science
question:
Sodium ion levels in the blood are controlled by a feedback loop. When sodium ion levels in the blood drop too low, the hormone aldosterone is released from the adrenal glands. Aldosterone causes the kidneys to reabsorb more sodium ions. This returns more sodium ions to the blood.
Which of the following will most likely occur when sodium ion levels in the blood return to normal?
choices: The aldosterone will begin to act on nerve cells.
The adrenal glands will stop releasing aldosterone.
The kidneys will reabsorb sodium ions at a faster rate.
The kidneys will signal the liver to filter sodium ions from the blood.
answer: B. The adrenal glands will stop releasing aldosterone.

subject: science
question:
Scientists studied how cycad trees affect the amount of nitrogen in soil over time. They compared the amount of nitrogen in an area with cycad trees to the amount of nitrogen in an area without cycad trees. The graph shows the scientists' results.
One scientist claims that plants in the area with cycad trees should grow larger than plants in the area with no cycad trees.
The scientist's claim is
A. supported by the graph.
B. not supported by the graph.
Which of the following describes the area with cycad trees?
A. There is more nitrogen available for plants to make waxy lipids.
B. There is more nitrogen available for plants to make structural proteins.
C. There is less nitrogen available for plants to make simple carbohydrates.
D. There is less nitrogen available for plants to make structural proteins.
answer: A (supported by the graph); B. There is more nitrogen available for plants to make structural proteins.

subject: science
question:
There are two coat varieties in cheetahs, king coats and normal coats. A cheetah with a king coat has larger spots than a cheetah with a normal coat. This coat variation is determined by a single gene with two alleles. When two cheetahs with normal coats are crossed, some of the cubs are expected to have king coats.
Based on the information, the inheritance pattern of coat variation in cheetahs is most likely
A. codominance.
B. dominant-recessive.
C. incomplete dominance.
The allele for king coat is
A. codominant.
B. dominant.
C. incompletely dominant.
D. recessive.
answer: B (dominant-recessive); D (recessive).

question:

The cheetah's habitat has changed due to human activities.
Part A: Habitat destruction threatens the cheetah's survival because it increases which of the following?
A. mating between cheetahs and other cat species
B. the number of environments to which cheetahs must adapt
C. the average age at which cheetahs stop caring for their young
D. competition for resources between cheetahs and other predators
Part B: The carrying capacity for cheetahs in Africa has
A. decreased.
B. increased.
C. remained the same.
This is because, due to habitat destruction, the amount of food available to the antelopes and zebras has
A. decreased.
B. increased.
C. remained the same.

The diagram represents a simplified version of the process of DNA replication.
Part A: Which of the following ensures that the two replicated DNA molecules are both identical to the original DNA molecule?
A. translation
B. transcription
C. sexual reproduction
D. complementary base pairing
Part B: Which of the following best explains why DNA replication must happen before mitosis can occur?
A. DNA can direct cell functions only after it has been replicated.
B. Protein synthesis requires that two identical copies of DNA be present.
C. Two copies of DNA are needed to produce identical cells during division.
D. The amount of energy needed to replicate DNA is available only before mitosis.
answer: Part A: D. complementary base pairing. Part B: C. Two copies of DNA are needed to produce identical cells during division.

subject: science
question:
A model of the cell cycle is shown.
Which of the following shows an event that occurs during interphase in the cell cycle?
choices: Chromosomes line up in the middle of a cell.
DNA is replicated in a nucleus of a cell.
Two nuclei form in a cell.
Chromosomes are separated in a cell.
answer: B. DNA is replicated in a nucleus of a cell.

picture.description: Circle diagram of the cell cycle: a large section labeled Interphase, a smaller wedge labeled Mitosis and a thin one labeled Cytokinesis. Each answer choice is a small cell drawing with the caption given here.

subject: science
question:
This question has two parts.
Part of the human excretory system is shown in the diagram.
Part A: Which of the following is a main function of the kidneys?
A. to filter waste from the blood
B. to control the exchange of gas
C. to transmit signals from the ureters
D. to break down carbohydrates with enzymes
Part B: Which of the following best describes how the kidneys help to maintain homeostasis?
A. They help to regulate the feedback loop for the body.
B. They help to regulate the volume of water in the body.
C. They help to regulate the temperature of all body cells.
D. They help to regulate the oxygen level in all body cells.
answer: Part A: A. to filter waste from the blood. Part B: B. They help to regulate the volume of water in the body.

picture.description: Kidneys with renal artery and renal vein, ureters, bladder and urethra, labeled.
